specs.title: seed a real journey through the product API
ord0302-N1 a non-JSON 5xx stays an HTTP answer with a visible device reading
ord0302-N2 a 4xx with the server's sentence still quotes it verbatim (positive control)
ord0302-N3 a genuine network failure keeps NETWORK and still renders the detail block
ord0302-X1 every 200 shape whose card points at 技术详情 renders a block that carries a reading
